text:
Sam Wu: FYI OrionX sent their RFI just now. Key asks: detailed capability matrix, security questionnaire answers (they attached an .xlsx), POC ops plan for a 3-week trial, and pricing tiers (POC vs reserved vs on-prem). PDF/attachments in the thread.

Ava Chen: I can own the capability matrix + CSV transform. Need to know whether to surface RAG/embedding infra as separate rows or fold under "model serving". Marcus, any preference?

Marcus Q: Separate rows please: Embeddings API, RAG orchestration, and Reranker should each have rows. OrionX is an NLP-heavy customer; they will want the embedding throughput numbers.

Ravi Kumar: Pricing quick note: we usually provide a three-tier snippet in RFIs: POC (short-term reserved mini pool), Pilot (time-limited with burst enabled), and Production reserved with commit discounts. I'll add a rate-card placeholder.

Leah Summers: Security: they asked about HSM options and FIPS level. Emily, can Legal/Sec confirm what we can say for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? Also they want SOC2 / ISO language.

Emily H: For Hosted: we can state SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 compliance where applicable, but do NOT claim FedRAMP without explicit approval. HSM: Hosted is a managed KMS (no customer HSM), Dedicated integrates with customer KMS (bring-your-own or HSM gateway), Private supports on-prem HSM appliances but will need an architecture review and export-control check. I'll redline any answers that suggest we ship specific HSM vendors.

Sam Wu: Good. Leah, please mark any rows that need Legal signoff in the CSV.

Ava Chen: Draft capability CSV schema I'm using (will attach):
```
feature,hosted_capability,dedicated_capability,private_capability,notes,requires_legal
Embeddings (vector API),High throughput (shared),Dedicated throughput (isolated),Customizable,Throughput numbers in ops doc,false
RAG orchestration,Managed connectors + caching,Isolated connectors + cache,Customer controlled connectors,Supports prefix/KV caching,true
Per-route latency SLOs,Platform targets (not SLA),SLA-backed per-route,Customer-defined,SLO values vary by plan,true
KV/prefix cache,Shared with tenant isolation,Per-tenant isolated,Configurable in-network,TTL per-tenant for Dedicated/Private,false
Model rollouts/canary,Platform rollouts,Configurable canary windows,Customer-driven,Supports fallback variants,false
Function/tool calling,Yes,Yes,Yes,Includes tool auth controls,false
Customer KMS integration,Managed keys,Integrates with KMS/HSM gateway,Full BYO HSM,Depends on deployment,true
On-prem HSM support,Not available,Optional add-on,Supported (appliance install),Requires arch review,true
Autoscaling and burst,Auto-burst for hosted,Configurable policies,Depends on infra,Supports burst tokens,false
Egress & private connectivity,Internet / peering,Private peering options,Direct network,Quoted separately,true
```

Ava Chen: I'll upload the CSV to the shared drafts folder.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: /attachments/orionx_rfi_received.xlsx (uploader: Sam Wu)

Marcus Q: Ops note for POC: we should propose a minimal acceptance criteria doc (3 success metrics: latency p95 under X ms, embedding recall above Y on their eval set, stability for 500 concurrent sessions). Also list data access needs (sample dataset, test queries, connectivity).

Leah Summers: I'll draft the POC acceptance criteria one-pager and include a short test harness example and the prompts we'll run.

Ravi Kumar: Pricing placeholder to add to the bundle (internal-only placeholders):
```
POC (3 weeks): pro-rated reserved mini-pool (1-2 GPU-equivalents) + burst; estimated $A for POC.
Pilot (1-3 months): small reserved commit with burst and telemetry; estimated $B/month.
Production (annual commit): dedicated capacity pricing with discounts; estimated $C/month + support tier.
Note: network egress and private connectivity quoted separately.
```

Emily H: Also: flag any RFI answer that mentions key export/import, HSM serial details, or vendor firmware. We must route those to Security & Compliance.

Sam Wu: Action items: Ava - finalize CSV and mark legal cells; Ravi - add pricing placeholders; Leah - POC acceptance page; Marcus - ops runbook and throughput numbers; Emily - legal redlines. I'll consolidate and send to OrionX after legal review. Timeline: end of day tomorrow for internal bundle.

Ava Chen: Uploaded capability CSV: https://s3.redwood.internal/drafts/orionx_capability_matrix_v1.csv. Please review and add comments.

Ravi Kumar: Added pricing placeholders to same folder. Ping me for numbers if they want concrete quotes.

Emily H: Received. I'll start the legal review and ping Security for the HSM/fedramp bits.

Sam Wu: Thanks all. If they push for a compressed POC start this week, we'll need exec sign-off for waived charge and ops standby. I'll loop in Erica for approval if it comes to that. :thumbsup:
